text:
maria_fin: Heads up — APAC vendor (ACME Cloud Infra) re-billed us for Q1 tariff adjustments. Invoice INV-AP-998 for $48,762.40 arrived this morning. Looks like it's for Jan–Mar network egress. Need direction on deferral vs expense and GL mapping. cc @ellie_rev @olivia_fp&a

samir_ops: Do we have the invoice PDF? can you drop link or attach CSV with line items? :mag:

maria_fin: Uploading summary to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/INV-AP-998-summary.pdf — main line is "Tariff surcharge" dated 2026-03-05. Vendor says charge applies to previously consumed capacity -> seems like post-billing adjustment.

jeff_billing: If it's a true-up for prior period usage, revenue impact depends on whether we passed the cost to customers. My initial read: vendor cost increase = COGS (6000), unless we billed customers for egress (pass-through).

ellie_rev: From revenue recognition side: if customers were billed usage that included egress, revenue may need to be adjusted. If we billed nothing, it's a vendor cost. Need per-customer mapping quickly.

olivia_fp&a: I pulled mapping rules — vendor rebills default to 6000-COGS:Network. However when we explicitly pass through to customers we map to Revenue schedules (9001/9002). Can we get a sample customer invoice to match lines?

maria_fin: Attaching sample customer invoice (CUST-9843) — egress line matches vendor qty & rates. So looks like we underbilled customers historically. That implies revenue we should recognize retroactively -> deferral reversal/adjustment needed.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-AP-998 processed into AP batch. VendorRef: VF-2026-03-05. Suggested staging GL: 2002-Accrued-Vendor -> 6000-COGS upon payment.

samir_ops: Note ASC 606/materiality concerns — if revenue impact is immaterial we might expense through P&L, otherwise restate. Finance to confirm materiality threshold.

ellie_rev: Quick calc from preliminary mapping: vendor charge $48,762.40, estimated pass-through to customers $32,500. Materiality threshold for a quarter is $25,000. This crosses threshold -> JE + disclosure required. Need detailed list of affected customers and schedule IDs.

olivia_fp&a: Agreed. We'll need per-customer breakout and the original revenue schedule IDs so we can adjust schedules rather than a blanket revenue hit. If customers were invoiced, we may need credit memos or supplemental invoices.

maria_fin: Drafting per-customer breakout now. Preliminary totals: CUST-9843 $8,200; CUST-9911 $12,300; CUST-10005 $6,000; remainder spread across ~15 small accounts. Will deliver CSV.

jeff_billing: Suggest routing the JE for approval to @ellie_rev. Proposed JE description: "APAC tariff retroactive pass-through — allocate to existing revenue schedules." Also include vendor invoice ref and cust invoice refs.

ellie_rev: Approve in principle. Request: maria_fin produce CSV with columns: customer_id, cust_invoice_no, vendor_line_ref, amt, rev_schedule_id, accounting_period. I will prepare disclosure note for close pack.

samir_ops: If customers weren't invoiced for pass-through, we should consider whether to invoice now (contract dependent) or accrue revenue until invoiced. Also confirm tax handling for retroactive charges.

maria_fin: Contract review in progress. For customers where contract allows retroactive billing we'll send supplemental invoices. For the rest we'll accrue revenue and reverse on billing.

olivia_fp&a: Draft JE (preview) — please validate:```
Date: 2026-03-31
Journal Description: APAC tariff retroactive pass-through allocation
Dr 4110 Accounts Receivable (cust invoices issued)  $32,500.00
Dr 2002 Accrued Revenue (for not-yet-invoiced)    $3,000.00
Cr 4000 Revenue - Usage Pass-through               $35,500.00
Dr 6000 COGS - Network (vendor cost)              $48,762.40
Cr 2002 Accrued-Vendor                             $48,762.40
Notes: allocate revenue lines to rev schedules 9001/9002/9003 per CSV mapping.```

jeff_billing: That looks ok as a starting point. We might split the revenue vs AR entries depending on whether we issue invoices or credit memos. I'll prepare the credit memo template for any customer where we need to correct prior billing.

ellie_rev: :thumbsup: Approve the JE draft once I receive the full CSV and confirmation of which customers will be invoiced vs accrued. If any single customer > $10k will need separate sign-off from FP&A lead.

maria_fin: Will send the CSV and invoice list by 17:00 PT today. Also including column "materiality_flag" where amt>10k.

samir_ops: FYI ops needs a short note for the console: will add a non-fatal alert that past usage lines may change for a small subset of customers. Helps SRE/support prepare for billing questions.

olivia_fp&a: Action items recap: 1) maria_fin -> deliver CSV (cust, cust_invoice_no, amt, rev_schedule_id, materiality_flag) by EOD. 2) jeff_billing -> prepare credit memo / supplemental invoice templates. 3) ellie_rev -> finalize JE and disclosure for month-end pack. 4) me -> coordinate GL booking and tax check.

ellie_rev: Thanks — once CSV is in I will update the month-end adjustments tracker and notify audit.

maria_fin: CSV uploaded: https://drive.redwood/finance/apac/INV-AP-998-customer-breakout.csv. Sending invites to a 4pm sync if needed. Thanks everyone.
